notes: Loopback HTTP/1.1, full-media simulated viewers, generated 360p30 H.264/AAC. Server, remuxing publishers and viewers share the host with existing workloads. One server CPU/RSS interval per trial, nominally aligned to viewer windows within 250 ms of launch spread. Viewer process/runtime startup adds unmeasured skew, so CPU sampling is not an exact viewer-window measurement. RSS sampled each second, excludes kernel memory. No recording, proxy, TLS, WAN, device, decoder or maximum-capacity claim.
